name: Madison

holders.note: The 2023 candidates for Madison Clerk-Treasurer were Sue Patterson (D) and Katie Rampy (R) (raw/martinsville-in/sos-2023-municipal-candidates-9-1-23.pdf). The city page now names Tabatha Eblen; a mid-term change is likely but no page says when.

holders.name: Carla Krebs
holders.note: State 2023 candidate list: Carla Eades Krebs.

council_map.vintage: UNKNOWN, probably the pre-2022 map. The PDF's metadata says created 2013-04-04 (Author 'twoodward', Title 'Think GIS'). The council page also embeds a PNG 'Council District Map' (raw/madison-in/council-district-map.png, 909x653, undated) that looks like the same five-colour layout. No precinct list, ordinance or GIS layer found.
council_map.notes: Jefferson County search found no council-district ArcGIS layer. A 2013 PDF cannot be the post-2020 redraw if the city redrew; Madison's population is about 12,000 so redistricting was due in 2022, but no ordinance was found. Confirm with the city clerk.

notes: Council page text: seven members, five by district and two at large, terms Jan 1 2024 to Dec 31 2027. No Madison city court on the state directory (raw/peru-in/court-directory.pdf lists Jefferson County Circuit and Superior only). Earlier search summaries named Shirley Rynearson as clerk-treasurer (2024) and a 2021 county list; the city page now shows a different name.
